title: Foundations
description: Understand how AI coding assistants work, what they can and cannot do, and how to set yourself up for success.
goals: Understand what AI coding assistants actually do under the hood
Distinguish between code completion, chat, and agentic coding
Evaluate when AI coding help is useful versus risky
Set up your first AI coding environment
tip: Install exactly one AI coding tool this week and use it exclusively — switching tools while learning the basics creates confusion.

title: Foundations Continued
description: Learn how to write effective prompts to get the best code suggestions from AI models.
goals: Apply core principles of prompting for coding tasks
Provide enough context for the AI to generate accurate code
Use iterative prompting techniques to refine output
Avoid common pitfalls in code generation prompts
tip: Treat the AI like a junior developer: give it clear requirements, show examples, and ask it to explain its reasoning.

title: Tools
description: Master GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT for code, Claude, Cursor, and other AI-powered development tools.
goals: Use GitHub Copilot effectively for daily coding tasks
Choose between ChatGPT, Claude, and Copilot for specific code tasks
Understand IDE-integrated AI tools like Cursor and Windsurf
Apply prompting strategies specific to code generation
tip: Configure Copilot to suggest completions only — resist the urge to let it write whole functions before you understand the pattern.

title: Tools Continued
description: Compare IDE-integrated AI tools and chat-based assistants to build your optimal coding toolkit.
goals: Compare Cursor and Copilot for your specific editor and workflow
Use chat assistants effectively for explaining and debugging code
Decide which tools belong in your daily stack versus occasional use
Troubleshoot common setup and configuration issues
tip: Document your tool setup in a simple README — you will forget exactly how you configured context and rules within a month.

title: Practical Workflows
description: Learn hands-on techniques for debugging, writing tests, and refactoring using AI assistants.
goals: Use AI to find the root cause of complex bugs faster
Write comprehensive test suites quickly with AI help
Refactor legacy code safely with AI suggestions
Automate documentation of codebases using AI
tip: When debugging, paste only the relevant function and error message — more context is not always better.

title: Practical Workflows Continued
description: Master writing tests and continue building reliable AI-assisted coding workflows.
goals: Generate unit tests, integration tests, and edge cases with AI
Apply test-driven development techniques assisted by AI
Build repeatable workflows for common development tasks
Maintain code quality while accelerating delivery with AI
tip: Always review generated tests carefully — AI is great at coverage but can miss edge cases specific to your domain.

title: Agentic Workflows
description: Learn how to use AI agents for multi-file refactoring, test generation, and full-stack development workflows.
goals: Understand how agentic coding differs from simple code completion
Use AI agents for multi-file refactoring tasks
Apply test-driven development with AI agent assistance
Plan and build features end-to-end with AI support
tip: Start agentic workflows on small, well-defined features — agents excel when the scope is clear and bounded.

title: Workflows Review and Practice
description: Consolidate your practical and agentic workflow skills through a capstone coding project.
goals: Debug a real bug using AI-assisted techniques
Refactor a small codebase safely with AI
Write a complete test suite for an existing module
Reflect on which AI workflows work best for your style
tip: Pair-program with AI on a real personal project this week — theory sticks best when applied to something you care about.

title: Advanced Techniques
description: Ensure that the AI-generated code is secure, properly tested, and production-ready.
goals: Identify common security vulnerabilities in AI-generated code
Use AI to generate meaningful test cases and edge cases
Review AI PRs and code suggestions with a critical eye
Apply static analysis and automated safeguards to AI output
tip: Never merge AI-generated code without reading every line yourself — speed is the goal, but security is non-negotiable.

title: Advanced Techniques Continued
description: Deepen your security and testing expertise with AI-assisted quality assurance.
goals: Audit an AI-generated feature for injection and auth flaws
Build a reusable AI testing workflow for your stack
Set up automated checks that catch AI mistakes before production
Create a code review checklist specifically for AI contributions
tip: Automate what you can: linting, formatting, and type checking will catch the majority of AI-generated bugs before review.

title: Capstone Project
description: Build a real project from start to finish using everything you have learned about AI-assisted coding.
goals: Scope and plan a small project using AI tools
Apply practical debugging, testing, and agentic workflows
Document your AI-assisted process for future reference
Present your project with notes on what worked and what did not
tip: Aim for a project that solves a real problem for you — motivation and real-world relevance beat tutorial exercises.

title: Review and Next Steps
description: Review your progress, consolidate your AI coding toolkit, and plan your continued growth.
goals: Review your capstone project and extract lessons learned
Curate a stable AI coding stack that fits your projects
Identify areas for continued learning and deeper study
Set a sustainable practice routine for staying current with AI coding tools
tip: Write a one-page personal guide: your preferred tools, your best prompts, and your non-negotiables for AI code review.
